test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Varun is three times as old as his sister. Six years hence the product of their ages will be 231. Find the Varun's present age.
solution:
**Given:**

Varun = 3 × Sister

**Concept used:**

x² – (sum of roots)x + product of roots = 0

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

(V + 6) × (S + 6) = 231

⇒ (3S + 6)(S + 6) = 231

⇒ 3S² + 18S + 6S + 36 = 231

⇒ 3S2 + 24S - 195 = 0

⇒ S2 + 8S - 65 = 0

⇒ S2 + 13S - 5S - 65 = 0

⇒ S(S + 13) - 5(S + 13) = 0

⇒ (S + 13)(S - 5) = 0

⇒ S = - 13, 5

Age cannot be in negative

So age of sister = 5 years

So, age of Varun is 15 years

**∴ Varun's present age is 15 years**
